newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sliver Grant sells 80 mln Qingling shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sliver Grant sells 80 mln Qingling shrs.

text.p: Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said on Friday it had sold 80 million Qingling Motors Co Ltd shares to instutional investors at HK$2.975 per share raising gross proceeds of HK$238 million.
The selling price was at a 2.5 percent discount to Qingling's closing price of HK$3.05 on Thursday, Silver Grant said in a statement.
The surplus before expenses to be derived from the disposal was around HK$166 million, it added.
Silver Grant said it intended to keep the rest of the shares for long-term investment purposes. It held about an eight percent stake in Qingling, the mainland China truck assembler, as of July 1996.
Silver Grant, which engages in property leasing, investment holding and share dealing, said the net proceeds of the sale would be used for working capital.
